paths.description: Public portal homepage and primary search entry point; desktop, dark preference, reduced motion, narrow viewport, no-JS crawler, performance, network, privacy and memory conditions.
Search-results archetype and completion of the homepage primary search journey; narrow viewport and no-JS crawler view.
News/listing content archetype selected from a prominent homepage story; narrow viewport and no-JS crawler view.
Authentication entry flow reached from the homepage, covering labels, autocomplete, alternate sign-in and account-flow clarity. Credentialed completion was intentionally not attempted.

findings.summary: Dark preference does not retint the homepage
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot remains a white surface and the probe reports color-scheme normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark surface and text tokens.

findings.summary: Auto-rolling motion continues under reduced-motion
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found two running 500 ms AutoRolling animations while the media query matched reduce.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential auto-rolling animation and auto-advance inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: High-contrast resilience is not established and baseline contrast already fails
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported a color-contrast failure; homepage CSS reports color-scheme normal with no forced-color adaptation signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Use system colors/forced-color-adjust deliberately and verify controls in forced-colors and prefers-contrast.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: The CSS/DOM probe found no view-transition declarations across a navigation-heavy portal.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive same-document or cross-document View Transitions to major tab and route changes, respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Long portal pages provide no scroll-state-aware chrome
findings.evidence: The probe found no scroll timeline/container-query implementation and the 3,608 px homepage has static chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Use declarative scroll-state or scroll-driven progress/affordances where they clarify position.

findings.summary: Transient overlays are manually positioned rather than anchored
findings.evidence: The homepage exposes autocomplete and banner overlays but the CSS probe found no anchor-positioning/container-query usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use anchor positioning with position-try fallbacks for transient menus and tooltips.

findings.summary: Browser promotion obscures primary homepage content on load
findings.evidence: The initial desktop screenshot shows a Whale update card covering the main promotional and news region.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not open promotional overlays on load; defer them and keep dismissal persistent and obvious.

findings.summary: Overlay-rich UI does not use semantic dialog/popover primitives
findings.evidence: The DOM probe counted no dialog, popover or details elements despite visible promotional and autocomplete overlays.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement transient layers with popover and modal flows with dialog, including declarative dismissal.

findings.summary: Dense chrome and promotions compete with content
findings.evidence: Homepage screenshots show multiple promotional banners, a floating update card, dense tabs and side widgets before core news/feed content.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce promotional chrome and prioritise search, news and user-selected content in the first viewport.

findings.summary: Desktop layouts are scaled down instead of reflowing at narrow widths
findings.evidence: At 360 px the homepage uses a 1,340 CSS-pixel layout; search uses 1,160 px and reports no viewport meta. Screenshots show miniature desktop columns.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width and responsive reflow at each host instead of fixed desktop viewport widths.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt at container level
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no container queries, while narrow screenshots preserve desktop cards and columns at reduced scale.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type and component-level queries for reused cards, navigation and side panels.

findings.summary: Many controls are undersized for touch
findings.evidence: The homepage probe found 51 of 161 visible interactive elements below 24 px in at least one dimension; Lighthouse also failed target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase touch targets to at least 24 by 24 CSS px with sufficient spacing and retain visible focus.

findings.summary: Homepage LCP is far outside the good range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 18.2 s LCP, 4.7 s FCP and performance 0.55; the independent trace measured 6.33 s LCP.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP resource, reduce critical request chains and defer non-essential modules/promotions.

findings.summary: Homepage has severe observed layout shift in a narrow condition
findings.evidence: The layout observer measured CLS 0.783, including a 0.724 shift around 6.16 s; 25 images lack dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve space for late content and media using dimensions/aspect-ratio and stabilise promotional slots.

findings.summary: Long tasks delay rendering on primary templates
findings.evidence: Trace recorded two long tasks up to 138 ms; news recorded a 421 ms task and search recorded 204 ms and 237 ms tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Break up expensive work, delay non-critical modules and schedule background work at lower priority.

findings.summary: Homepage delivery is heavy and delays the main content
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 170 requests and 5.86 MB transferred, including 2.86 MB images and 2.00 MB scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten critical chains, preload only the true LCP resource, improve caching and defer below-fold assets.

findings.summary: JavaScript and third-party delivery dominate the load
findings.evidence: The HAR records 52 scripts transferring 2.00 MB across 18 origins; Lighthouse performance remains 0.55.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit bundles and code coverage, remove duplicate/unused modules, and load optional portal modules on demand.

findings.summary: Accessible names and role relationships fail
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed aria-required-children, image-alt and link-name; the image probe found 39 images without alt and the search input had no programmatic label.
findings.suggestedFix: Repair required ARIA ownership, name links and search, and supply meaningful alt or empty alt for decorative images.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails the accessibility baseline
findings.evidence: Lighthouse explicitly failed the color-contrast audit on the mobile homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG AA in every state and theme.

findings.summary: Landmark and heading structure is inconsistent
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed heading-order and landmark-one-main; the homepage uses role=main on a div rather than a native main landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a single native main landmark and a sequential heading hierarchy; preserve the visible focus treatment.

findings.summary: Narrow views render desktop text at miniature scale
findings.evidence: The 360/390 px screenshots show entire desktop multi-column layouts shrunk to fit, making body text difficult to read.
findings.suggestedFix: Reflow content at narrow widths and use fluid, readable type and line lengths rather than page-scale shrinkage.

findings.summary: Viewport policy and touch targets obstruct zoom/reflow
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport and target-size; the homepage declares width=1190 and 51 controls are below 24 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width without restrictive scaling, reflow at 320 CSS px, and enlarge touch targets.

findings.summary: Browser errors occur during load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed errors-in-console on the mobile homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the logged resource/runtime errors and add monitoring to prevent regressions.

findings.summary: Image sizing and aspect-ratio hygiene is weak
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed image-aspect-ratio; 25 images lack dimensions and 4 are oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio and serve correctly cropped responsive variants.

findings.summary: The homepage is not eligible for reliable BFCache restoration
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported three BFCache failure reasons.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove avoidable unload/cache blockers and retest back-forward restoration in DevTools.

findings.summary: Homepage crawl and mobile signals conflict with a public portal
findings.evidence: robots.txt disallows all paths except the root, the page emits index,nofollow, has 52 hash-only links, and uses viewport width=1190.
findings.suggestedFix: Use descriptive crawlable hrefs, a device-width viewport and intentional robots/indexing policy for public surfaces.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie flags are incomplete
findings.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS and DENY framing are present, but CSP and nosniff are missing; 7 cookies were flagged insecure and several use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an enforcing CSP and nosniff, then mark all HTTPS cookies Secure with the narrowest SameSite policy.

findings.summary: The homepage has a broad third-party/subdomain footprint
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence recorded 18 origins, 17 outside www.naver.com; the HAR transferred 5.86 MB and long-lived 400-day cookies were set.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory each origin and identifier, remove non-essential calls, shorten retention and batch/defer analytics.

findings.summary: Sign-in does not expose phishing-resistant passkeys
findings.evidence: The login probe found no passkey text or WebAuthn signal; only password, QR and federated methods were visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey authentication and registration alongside recovery-friendly alternatives.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policy is incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers lack CSP, Permissions-Policy and nosniff; Referrer-Policy is unsafe-url. HSTS and X-Frame-Options are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a restrictive Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, nosniff and CSP with frame-ancestors/Trusted Types where applicable.

findings.summary: Homepage core content disappears without JavaScript
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 5% raw/rendered word coverage, an empty #root, and a blank crawler screenshot, while search and news retained 99–100%.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the homepage core search/navigation/content and layer client interactivity as enhancement.

findings.summary: App-like portal has no manifest, service worker or offline entry state
findings.evidence: The homepage probe found no manifest and no controlling service worker despite the portal behaving as a long-lived app surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a web app manifest and a useful cached offline shell/fallback for core navigation and search entry.

findings.summary: Persistent browser promotion creates a nagging default experience
findings.evidence: A Whale promotion spans the top and a second floating update prompt obscures content on initial load.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove repeated on-load promotion, persist dismissal and avoid pre-empting the user’s task.

findings.summary: Sign-in fields omit autocomplete tokens
findings.evidence: The login probe found empty autocomplete values for the username and password fields.
findings.suggestedFix: Set username and current-password autocomplete tokens and retain password-manager compatibility.

findings.summary: Image delivery is not resolution- or format-efficient
findings.evidence: Of 69 images, 32 use legacy formats, none use AVIF/WebP, 40 lack srcset, 31 below-fold images are not lazy and 4 are oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive sources, lazy-load below-fold images and send dimensions appropriate to display size.

findings.summary: Large script/origin footprint performs avoidable background work
findings.evidence: The homepage loads 52 scripts and 170 requests across 18 origins before user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate optional feeds/ads/widgets on visibility or intent and deprioritise background fetching.

findings.summary: Third-party and media budget is disproportionate for a portal entry page
findings.evidence: The first load transfers 5.86 MB, including 2.86 MB images, and contacts 17 non-www origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Set per-template byte/origin budgets and defer promotional media and non-essential third-party modules.

findings.summary: Core homepage capabilities are not exposed in a structured agent-readable form
findings.evidence: The homepage is a 5%-coverage JS shell and the probe found no structured agent capability; agents must scrape dynamic UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose safe search/navigation actions through structured agentic forms or WebMCP where appropriate.
